intro: Good Steel is an Alliance quest originating at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. In the wake of recent conflicts, high-quality metal has become scarce, leaving the camp's woodcutting equipment worn and difficult to replace. Craftsman Hagar Lowe tasks adventurers with delving into Jasperlode Mine to salvage well-crafted pickaxes so their steel can be repurposed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the mine yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
